name: Super Coupon Club
summary:
Join Victoria and her rag tag group of underground after-market coupon counterfeiters collectively known as the Super Coupon Club as they take on the new Corporate Super Mart!

Utilize up to 25 unique coupons in order to take down the Super Mart within 7 rounds to show those snooty suits you ladies really run this town in this Roguelike Deck builder.
